### Problem Statement
Is your feature request related to a problem? Please describe clearly.
*Example: As a student, I find it difficult to know which open-source projects match my current roadmap level...*

### Proposed Solution
A clear and concise description of what you want to happen.

### Alternatives Considered
A clear and concise description of any alternative solutions or workarounds you have considered.

### Target User Role
- [ ] Student
- [ ] Corporate Recruiter
- [ ] College / Campus Administrator
- [ ] System Administrator

### UI / UX Considerations
Does this feature impact user interfaces? (Remember Disheera enforces strict light-theme EduTech design guidelines).

### Additional Context
Add any other context, wireframes, or mockups here.
